name: Terraform MCP Server for Cisco Secure Firewall
shortDescription: MCP server exposing Terraform validate, plan, explain, and drift detection for Cisco Secure Firewall, with apply disabled by default.
description: Gives an AI agent the Terraform workflow for Secure Firewall as read-only tools: version reporting, init with -backend=false, structured validate diagnostics, plan-to-file with a compact sanitised change summary, resource-by-resource plan explanation, refresh-only drift detection, and a sanitised state summary. Values Terraform marks sensitive are replaced with a placeholder before they leave the server, so credentials never reach the model context. Workspaces are addressed by allowlisted name, never by path. terraform apply is disabled until TF_MCP_ALLOW_APPLY=true and additionally requires a confirmation token bound to the reviewed change summary; it applies the saved plan file, closing the plan-then-apply-something-else gap.

tools.name: plan_workspace
tools.description: Plan to file; sanitised change summary plus a confirmation token.

tools.name: explain_plan
tools.description: Resource-by-resource narrative of the saved plan.

tools.name: detect_drift
tools.description: Refresh-only plan: what changed outside Terraform.

tools.name: apply_plan
tools.description: Apply the saved plan. Gated by TF_MCP_ALLOW_APPLY and a plan-bound token.

safety.confirmationBinding: HMAC over workspace + change counts + destructive flag + sorted resource addresses, per-process key, 900s TTL
safety.sensitiveValueRedaction: Terraform sensitive marks honoured in both plan and state output

thirdParty.relationship: Invoked as an external binary. Copied from the official image at container build time; not redistributed in source form.
Downloaded by terraform init from the public Terraform Registry. Not redistributed.

support: Community, best effort. Not supported by Cisco TAC.
